fewShots.question: What is the CU utilization right now?
fewShots.query: CapacitySummary | where Timestamp > ago(10m) | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, CuPercent, InteractivePercent, BackgroundPercent, InteractiveDelayThresholdPercent) by CapacityName

fewShots.question: What were the p95 and peak CU in the last 24 hours?
fewShots.query: CapacitySummary | where Timestamp > ago(24h) | summarize p95_cu = percentile(CuPercent, 95), peak_cu = max(CuPercent), peak_at = arg_max(CuPercent, Timestamp) by CapacityName

fewShots.question: Will we throttle in the next hour?
fewShots.query: CapacitySummary | where Timestamp > ago(30m) | summarize window_now = arg_max(Timestamp, InteractiveDelayThresholdPercent), window_30m_ago = arg_min(Timestamp, InteractiveDelayThresholdPercent) by CapacityName

fewShots.question: Show anomalies in the last 24 hours
fewShots.query: CapacitySummary | where Timestamp > ago(24h) and AnomalyScore > 3 | project Timestamp, CapacityName, CuPercent, AnomalyScore | order by Timestamp desc

fewShots.question: Which semantic models should we fix first?
fewShots.query: BpaFindings | where ScannedAt == toscalar(BpaFindings | summarize max(ScannedAt)) | summarize errors = countif(Severity == 'Error'), warnings = countif(Severity == 'Warning') by ModelName, WorkspaceName | order by errors desc, warnings desc | take 10

fewShots.question: Which workspace uses the most CU?
fewShots.query: CapacityOperation | where Timestamp > ago(24h) | summarize cu_seconds = sum(CuSeconds), operations = count() by WorkspaceName | top 10 by cu_seconds desc
